dataManagement.title: Purge data by interval
dataManagement.description: Irreversibly deletes every trace of data in a date interval: substitutions, invigilations and freed groups, exported PDFs and XML versions fully contained within the interval. First analyse what would be deleted; then confirm to execute.
dataManagement.nothingToDelete: Nothing to delete in this interval.
dataManagement.confirmMessage: This will delete {bd} DB records, {pdf} PDFs and {xml} XML versions from the interval {start} → {end}. This action CANNOT be undone. Continue?
dataManagement.resultSuccess: Purge completed ({start} → {end}): {bd} DB records, {pdf} PDFs and {xml} XML versions deleted.
dataManagement.warnXmlActive: The XML version starting {start} is the ACTIVE one (covers the present). It is kept locked: deleting it would leave the app without a timetable.
dataManagement.warnXmlExtends: The XML version {start} → {end} extends outside the interval. It is kept locked to avoid affecting dates outside it.
dataManagement.warnPdfsManual: {n} PDFs (management/staff reports) have no date in their name and will NOT be deleted automatically; review them manually.
dataManagement.anonDescription: Rename a teacher no longer in the timetable (inactive) to remove their identity from historical records, keeping the counts. Covers the right to erasure.
dataManagement.anonHint: Inactive teachers only. To change an active teacher, edit it in FET and re-import.

intro.welcomeBody: This web app manages substitutions and exam supervisions for educational institutions.
intro.navigationBody: Use the top tabs to switch between:

items.groupsBody: Define which groups are released per hour

generatePending.title: Generate pending
generatePending.body: Automatically assigns only pending substitutions, preserving existing assignments. Useful to add new absences without recalculating everything.

regenerate.title: Regenerate all
regenerate.body: Regenerates all substitutions from scratch following the configured priority order. Warning: this will remove all current manual assignments.

newAbsence.title: New absence
newAbsence.body: Add or edit a teacher's absences for the selected day. You can select multiple hours and indicate if it's for service.

savePdf.title: Generate PDF
savePdf.body: Generate a full PDF with substitutions and/or supervisions for the day. The system validates conflicts before generating the document.

assignManual.title: Assign substitute manually
assignManual.body: Click the “Substitute” dropdown to see all available teachers. Colors indicate the status:

new.title: New supervision
new.body: Create a new supervision by specifying hour, level, exam type, groups, and room. The supervisor can be assigned manually or left blank for automatic assignment.

assignOwners.title: Assign owners
assignOwners.body: Phase 1 of automatic assignment. Assign only owner teachers who have class with the examined group and are freed. Preference: owner with the group > freed owner.

assignPending.title: Assign pending
assignPending.body: Phase 2 of automatic assignment in two passes:

available.title: Available
available.body: If pending remain, ask whether to assign available teachers (guard, free periods)

export.title: Export PDF
export.body: Generate a PDF of supervisions for the selected day. You can choose:

interval.title: Interval PDF
interval.body: Generate a single PDF with supervisions for multiple days. Useful for planning full exam periods.

general.title: General configuration
general.body: Access it using the settings button (⚙️) in the top bar.

exam.title: Exam configuration
exam.body: Access it using the exam settings button (⚡).

steps.selectDate: Select the date in the top calendar
steps.generate: Click “⚡ Generate pending” to assign automatically
steps.review: Review and adjust manually if needed
steps.pdf: Generate a PDF to communicate to staff

items.define: First define all supervisions for the day
items.assignOwners: Run “🎯 Assign owners” to cover with group teachers

groups.title: Groups without class
groups.body: Configure released groups for each hour correctly. This improves automatic assignment of substitutions and supervisions because the system prioritizes freed teachers.

filters.title: Filters and search
filters.body: In the supervisions view you can filter by:

factor_refredament.help: Convergence speed (close to 1 = slower but better)

max_intents_validacio.help: How many solutions are tried to find the best one

seeds_count.label: Number of seeds
seeds_count.help: Try multiple seeds and keep the best solution

publish.optionClear: Clear existing vigilancies for these dates
publish.previewDesc: This is what will happen when you confirm publication. Nothing has been written to the database yet.

perSlot.title: By Hour/Day
perSlot.desc: For each hour and day: groupings sorted by cost (optimal, good and acceptable).

perGroup.title: By Grouping
perGroup.desc: For each grouping: all available slots with cost and impact details.

teachersPerSlot.title: Teachers per Slot
teachersPerSlot.desc: Available and released teachers for each slot, according to active levels.

costs.substitucioDesc: Cost for a teacher with class during the exam.
costs.abansJornadaDesc: Cost when the teacher arrives before their shift.
costs.despresJornadaDesc: Cost when the teacher leaves after their shift.

groups.title: Exam groupings
groups.subtitle: Define bundles that should be placed as a single unit.
groups.description: You can add standalone subjects or groups. Filter by level to work faster.

durades.title: Exam durations
durades.exceptionsDesc: Subjects that require different durations from the default. You can group multiple subjects with the same duration.
durades.emptyMessage: No groups defined. All subjects use the default duration.

teachers.title: Limit exams per teacher on specific days
teachers.description: Limits how many exams a teacher can have on specific days.

daysHours.title: Subjects fixed or prohibited at a specific day and/or hour
daysHours.description: Fix subjects to a specific slot (Fix mode) or prohibit them from falling there (Prohibit mode). Example: English → Prohibit Friday 11:30.

strictSchedule.description: Teachers who CANNOT arrive earlier or leave later than their usual schedule

dayPreferences.title: Preferences: same day or different days (with individual weight)

incompatibilities.title: Subject groups that CANNOT coincide in the same slot
incompatibilities.description: Subject groups that cannot coincide on the same day and time (slot). Useful to avoid simultaneous exams for the same teacher.

costs.title: Teacher costs
costs.description: These costs are shown in incidents and used to compute total cost.

analysis.title: Feasibility analysis
analysis.subtitle: Analyze which groupings can be placed in each slot and which teachers are available.
analysis.noneReason: (All teachers have classes in other levels or no activity)
